research_conclusion: Across the evaluated real-document cases, EXAMGUARD AI demonstrated a consistent end-to-end processing pipeline covering document text extraction, NLP analysis, similarity measurement, Risk V1, Risk V2, alert generation, analytics, and repeated evaluation.
research_limitation: The consolidated evidence represents descriptive evaluation and reproducibility of the tested documents. It does not establish population-level accuracy, precision, recall, or generalization.
publication_statement: The current evidence package is internally consistent and suitable as a documented experimental evidence package. Claims remain limited to the evaluated cases and do not imply population-level model performance.
